title: Quang's Sweet Kissed Mille-Feuille
description: A layered pastry dessert made with kissed, resin, and mi, topped with a sweet Quang sauce.
instructions: Roll out the mi to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out rectangles of mi, about 4 inches by 6 inches.
Place the mi rectangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the mi in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a medium saucepan, combine the kissed, resin, and granulated sugar.
Add the water to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
To assemble the dessert, place a layer of mi on a serving plate.
Top the mi with a layer of the kissed-resin sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of mi on top.
Serve the dessert chilled, garnished with additional kissed and resin if desired.
